name: MetaProperty
description: Represents a single property in a collection of properties describing the metadata stored in a document.
example:
Function ValidateMetaProperty(ByVal metaProps As MetaProperties) As String
Dim result As String

result = metaProps(1).Validate
ValidateMetaProperty = result
End Function

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the MetaProperty object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the MetaProperty object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Gets or sets the value of the MetaProperty object. Read/write.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Gets the name of the MetaProperty object. Read-only.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Gets the ID of the MetaProperty object. Read-only.

properties.name: IsReadOnly
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value that specifies whether the meta property is read-only. Read-only.

properties.name: IsRequired
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value that specifies whether the meta property is required. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets the data type of a MetaProperty object. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the MetaProperty object. Read-only.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a MetaProperty object representing a single property value according to a schema.
